mechanism: Bumetanide-induced electrolyte depletion (potassium, magnesium) and volume depletion may increase everolimus toxicity and reduce renal function, while everolimus can cause fluid retention opposing diuretic effects.
action: Monitor electrolytes, renal function, and everolimus levels closely; maintain adequate potassium and magnesium supplementation; adjust bumetanide dose if necessary based on clinical response.
